About This Class
In this class, you'll learn how to create an Al-generated product image and turn it into a realistic, editable mockup for your patterns, using
Adobe Photoshop.
We'll create a starting image using an Al tool such as ChatGPT, Midjourney or any other ai tool.
Then bring it into Photoshop and transform it into a realistic product mockup.
You'll learn how to apply your pattern, adjust brightness, contrast and colour, experiment with different colourways, and save a clean,
reusable mockup for future projects.
